Make reporting gaps reviewable before an authorized filing

Bring synthetic report status, source-quality exceptions, filing-state evidence, and audit findings into one regulatory brief while leaving certification, signature, and transmission to authorized owners.

**Why try it:** A reporting lead can ask what is overdue or incomplete and receive the exact report, evidence gap, owner, and approval boundary.

## Problem Statement

Regulatory data, completion status, validation evidence, and audit findings live across systems, slowing preparation and obscuring who must resolve each issue.

## Solution Summary

Microsoft Copilot Studio can provide the governed front door; approved regulatory data, a controlled reporting workspace, SharePoint, Teams, and a separately authorized filing connector can support production use.

**Blueprint role:** Preserves the Regulatory Reporting module as a distinct Energy Operations preparation layer before certification, signature, and filing.

**Capabilities:** Reporting portfolio status; Source-data validation screening; Read-only filing-state tracker; Audit evidence triage. See [responsibilities and trust boundaries](2.Architecture.md).

## Business Outcomes

- Improves visibility into overdue reports and source-quality exceptions.
- Creates a consistent audit-readiness handoff with named evidence and owners.
- Preserves regulatory accountability by separating preparation from certification and filing.

Claims are qualitative; synthetic demo figures are not customer results or performance commitments. See the [claims policy](../../solutions/README.md#claims-policy).

## Target Users

| Role | Need |
| --- | --- |
| Regulatory Reporting Lead | See which synthetic filing is overdue and who owns it; filing actions stay with authorized regulatory owners. |
| Data Analyst | Find incomplete or below-threshold report data before an authorized owner attests the evidence. |
| Compliance Manager | Confirm recorded filing state and that the agent transmitted nothing. |
| Internal Auditor | Triage open high-severity evidence gaps without an audit-outcome prediction. |

## In Scope / Out of Scope

### In scope

- Summarize the synthetic report portfolio by deadline with authority, facility, owner, completion, quality and status.
- Screen evaluated reports for incomplete collection or below-threshold quality and name the authorized report owner who must resolve and attest the evidence.
- Show recorded submission state, owner and last update as read-only tracking that states no filing, signature or transmission occurred.
- Group audit findings by report and count open and high-severity open items without predicting an audit outcome.
- Filter to an exact synthetic report ID; an unknown ID returns no invented report.

### Out of scope / approval boundary

- No live regulatory data, reporting workspace, evidence library or filing connector; only the uploaded synthetic knowledge and operation skills are used.
- No signing, certifying, transmitting or claiming completion of a regulator filing.
- No audit-outcome prediction or legal advice; readiness triage organizes findings only.
- No regulator-ready report assembly; the source validates synthetic status evidence only.
- No browsing for replacement facts and no substitute record when an identifier is absent.
- No workshop publishing: validated agents stay Draft, and publishing is a separate human approval gate.

## Qualification Checklist

- [ ] Is a Copilot Studio target environment with an approved publisher prefix available for the regulatory reporting build?
- [ ] Can the delivery team authenticate with PAC CLI 2.9.3 or newer and initialize a `cli-copilot` project?
- [ ] Has the customer mapped report status, validation evidence and audit findings to its data lake, reporting workspace and SharePoint evidence library?
- [ ] Will any filing connector require authenticated tools, authorization checks, explicit human approval and an audit log before a write?
- [ ] Are authorized regulatory owners named to approve source evidence and every filing action?
- [ ] Has the customer decided how Microsoft Teams supports review and escalation, separately from the synthetic workshop?
- [ ] Is publication held for a separate human approval after every locked case is replayed in the target environment?
- [ ] Have replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures been agreed for production reporting?

## What Actually Goes Wrong

- **substituted-report:** An unknown or mistyped report ID is answered with another report's evidence.
- **screening-read-as-attestation:** A validation result is treated as attested or certified source evidence.
- **tracking-read-as-filing:** Recorded filing state is taken as proof that the agent filed, signed or transmitted a report.
- **audit-outcome-prediction:** Readiness triage is presented as a predicted audit result or legal advice.
- **fictional-thresholds-adopted:** Synthetic quality scores, completeness and deadlines are adopted as the customer's validation rules.
- **partial-ingestion:** Preview runs while knowledge is still processing, and a partial answer is accepted.
- **missing-grounding:** A skill or its knowledge cannot load, and the agent answers from memory.

See [state and recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery).
